title: The Midnight Recovery and Sisterly Bond — Part 3

cuts.voiceover_text: Confined to a dim quarantine room, the cat girl rests under heavy blankets while a figure in a protective hazmat suit monitors her vitals.
Across town, her younger sister Imoko urgently navigates crowded pharmacy aisles with friends to secure vital medicine.
The group debates remedies beside the supply shelves, refusing to let illness or bad decisions tear their makeshift family apart.
Under the soft blue moonlight, a tender phone call bridges the distance as the recovering cat girl whispers her quiet gratitude. The crisis has passed, and she is finally safe.

series.summary: Quarantined and cared for by protective companions, the cat girl recovers as her sister Imoko brings aid, bringing peace under the midnight sky.
